meta.title: A line-item to lot closing-mode switch on a multi-product trade is refused
gaps: The available setup recipes create only one line item, so the multi-product starting state is not created.
The request does not include a multi-product data payload because the required product identifiers are not available as tokens.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot award entire lot when RFQ was done for partial lot.”, and never with a server error.

expected.message: You cannot award entire lot when RFQ was done for partial lot.
